items.description: Certificate of completion for Anthropic's introductory course on Claude. Covers Claude's capabilities and model family, effective prompting techniques, and how to apply Claude across everyday and professional workflows.

items.title: Google AI
items.description: Specialization certificate bundling 7 completed Google AI courses: AI Fundamentals, AI for Brainstorming and Planning, AI for Research and Insights, AI for Writing and Communicating, AI for Content Creation, AI for Data Analysis, and AI for App Building. Demonstrates fluency in applying AI across workflows, content creation, analysis, and app development.

items.title: AI for Data Analysis
items.description: Covers how to identify success metrics using AI to analyze business objectives, generate spreadsheet formulas via natural language instructions with Gemini in Google Sheets, clean and structure messy data through effective prompting, and create AI-powered data visualizations to communicate insights.

items.title: AI for App Building
items.description: Explores how to analyze professional workflows to identify high-impact AI opportunities, construct functional web applications using vibe coding techniques, evaluate technical issues with AI-assisted debugging, and leverage advanced tools like AI Studio to build scalable custom solutions.

items.title: AI for Content Creation
items.description: Covers how to generate high-quality visual assets from a creative concept using Gemini's image and video generation models, establish custom design guidelines, and critique creative assets by prompting AI to provide actionable feedback based on design criteria.

items.title: AI for Writing and Communicating
items.description: Explores how to leverage AI tools to improve written communication, draft professional content, refine tone and clarity, and accelerate document workflows using generative AI within Google Workspace.

items.title: AI for Research and Insights
items.description: Covers how to apply AI tools to research workflows, synthesize large volumes of information, and extract structured insights from unstructured data using generative AI.

items.title: AI for Brainstorming and Planning
items.description: Explores how to use AI to accelerate ideation, structure complex plans, and improve decision-making processes through targeted prompting and collaborative AI workflows.

items.title: AI Fundamentals
items.description: Introduces core AI and machine learning concepts, the landscape of generative models, and practical use cases for applying AI responsibly in everyday professional tasks.
